Notification.note: Toaster is a mount point that renders nothing until a toast is pushed; this cell fires a real toast on mount with duration Infinity, over a stand-in workspace pane. Popover fill, border, radius and the text-ui/text-ui-sm pair are all the DS's own classNames.

WithAction.note: Toast with an action button, which picks up the bg-primary/text-primary-foreground override from the Toaster's kitClassNames.

Stacked.note: Three toasts in the expanded stack, including the success and error variants with their leading icons.

TopRight.note: Same toast with position='top-right', showing that the region is positionable without colliding with page content.
